question: How does the lord of the wheel appear in relation to subtle consciousness?
premises: The lord of the wheel is full of subtle consciousness that is unopened and dissolved.
He shines in a manner comparable to the peacock-feather analogy.
His appearance is variegated by activities of closing and opening.
inference: The lord of the wheel manifests diverse activities while remaining grounded in subtle, unmanifest consciousness.
plain_english: In the same way, the lord of the wheel shines, full of subtle consciousness that is unopened and dissolved, and made variegated by the activities of closing and opening.
